description: This is a unit test source file for the class TelemetrySenderImpl, testing its messaging behavior within the Eclipse Hono client implementation.

classes.name: TelemetrySenderImplTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the TelemetrySenderImpl class, particularly message sending logic, handling of peer settlement, timeout scenarios, and interaction with dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating mock objects and setting up the environment before each test.

methods.name: testSendMessageDoesNotWaitForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Tests that sending a message does not wait for peer acknowledgment and succeeds immediately.

methods.name: testSendAndWaitForOutcomeFailsOnLackOfCredit
methods.description: Verifies that sending fails when there is no credit for message transmission.

methods.name: testSendMessageFailsOnTimeout
methods.description: Ensures that a timeout during message send results in proper cleanup and span finishing.
